meta.purpose: Warn-only calibration benchmark for the PMA STR seasonal-share discount (#1171).
meta.method_note: Licensed STR counts are not ACS vacant-for-rent units. They use different universes and dates; compare only for order-of-magnitude calibration. License counts are advisory only and are never scoring inputs.
meta.source_rules: Each row was queried from an official municipal/county ArcGIS or open-data endpoint on 2026-07-14. Absent jurisdictions are preferable to unverifiable or remembered counts. Rows added 2026-10-14 were queried the same way that day. Summit County's unincorporated layer (2,298 records, an undocumented Active field) and Telluride's layer (a 2025 permit-year snapshot uploaded by a consultant) were left out as not a current license count.

entries.source_note: City and County of Denver table 'Short Term Rental-Licenses Active or Pending Renewal'; query returned count 2386.
City of Manitou Springs service 'Short Term Rentals' / 'Active Short Term Rentals'; query returned count 51.
Town of Lyons service 'Licensed Short Term Rentals'; query returned count 16.
Lake County, Colorado GIS service 'Compliant STR 2024'; query returned count 132.
Clear Creek County STR license parcel service; distinct active licenseNumber query returned 154 features.

City of Aspen GIS server, layer 'Existing STR Permit'. The query on 2026-10-14 returned count 753, all with distinct PermitNum; latest last_edited_date is 2026-09-03. PermitType: STR-C / Classic 670, STR-OO / Owner-Occupied 74, STR-LE / Lodging Exempt 7, blank 2. A hosted copy (services3.arcgis.com/5FkYBrhNzpVtlA6F/.../STR/FeatureServer/0) returned 747 and is older.

Town of Avon ArcGIS (owner of the Town's asset and transit layers), item 'Short-Term Rental Addresses': 'Avon addresses located on parcels or lodging properties where short-term rentals are authorized.' The query on 2026-10-14 returned 1155 address records (all Retired='No', all with a license number); dataLastEditDate is 2026-08-18. Those addresses map to only 342 distinct License__ values, because a front-desk-managed lodge holds one license for many units. Use 1155 as units and 342 as licenses. Type split, from a grouped query that totals 1115 rather than 1155: Front Desk managed 792, Full License 299, Limited 14, Resident Occupied 10.

City of Boulder GIS, layer 'Rental Housing Licenses', the source of the City's Rental License Map. Queries on 2026-10-14: RENTALTYPE LIKE '%Short Term%' AND LICENSESTATUS='Issued' returned 936; RENTALTYPE='Short Term Rental' AND Issued alone returned 896; all statuses with any Short Term type returned 1034. Excluded: 834 'Festival Lodging Rental' licenses. Live layer with no edit timestamp, so as_of is the query date.
